batch_scope: explicit user request; frozen ordered URLs; recent excludes pinned unless specified
helper_surface: Chrome native accessibility through documented cua_repl API
ellipsis_identity_fallback: documented tab metadata only with address, HTML title and selected-tab title agreement
default_persistence: disabled; explicit opt-in with private local config

knowledge_graph.refresh: on journal export, using the same consistent database snapshot
knowledge_graph.stale_policy: source signature change quarantines relations; never auto-promote H

obsidian.conflict_policy: stop before note writes; retry export only
obsidian.evidence: copy sourced tiers; never promote H
obsidian.mail_policy: no new send or attachment rewrite

recovery.save_authorization: one committed SQLite intent per run and URL; first acknowledgement only
recovery.reset_policy: rediscover stable Chrome identity; restore frozen journal; uncertain saves verify only
recovery.evidence: atomic observation envelope; cached results cannot claim freshness
recovery.regression: synthetic UI and temporary databases; live fault injection not run
recovery.load_recovery: same frozen run; explicit reopen after body ready; toCorrection appends and preserves BLOCKED
recovery.actual_title: no-op result reads the same fresh sidebar row as its observation
recovery.replay: cached targets are skipped; exact correction and graph export retries are idempotent
recovery.mail_after_correction: same delivery key; preserve existing sent snapshot; never automatically resend

email_archive.deduplication: one run_id and recipient; durable claim; payload issued once
email_archive.readback: full headers plus raw MIME body and attachment byte hashes
email_archive.scope: self-addressed report only; no chat bodies or credentials
body_sections: configured-timezone deduplicated relation additions and tiers
email_archive.sample_policy: explicit user request only; separate stable sample ledger and key; never daily retry bypass

default_title_language: English; preserve adequate titles; user override supported
